name: Alistair Finch
bio:
Alistair Finch's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines on his family's farm in rural New Zealand. His analytical mind quickly led him to race strategy, where he excelled at predicting competitor moves and optimizing pit stop timings. He honed his skills in various racing series across the Pacific before joining RFK Racing.

Alistair's approach to strategy is deeply rooted in data analysis and risk assessment. He believes in meticulous preparation, studying every possible scenario to ensure the team is ready for any eventuality. His calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to quickly adapt to changing conditions have made him a valuable asset to the team.

Alistair's distinctive quality is his ability to blend traditional racing wisdom with cutting-edge technology. He is not afraid to challenge conventional thinking and is always looking for innovative ways to gain a competitive edge. His experience and innovative mindset make him a key figure in RFK Racing's pursuit of victory.

physical.description: Alistair is a tall, lean man with a focused gaze and a salt-and-pepper goatee.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Insists on having a cup of strong black coffee before every race.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically against the table when deep in thought.
